Award-winning design, innovation and durability

With 70 years of history, Docol is a benchmark in sanitary fittings that combine sophisticated design, high performance and a commitment to sustainability. Its products have recognized quality and cutting-edge technology, such as the DocolChroma finish and the DocolMatic automatic system.

Functionality and sophistication in every environment
Docol faucets and mixers offer practicality and elegance, with precise water control and options for kitchens and bathrooms. Featuring aerator technology and a versatile design, they guarantee comfort, savings, and perfect adaptation to any decorating style.
Sustainability and comfort in your daily life
Docol invests in sustainable processes, guaranteeing durable products that reduce water consumption without compromising performance. Whether it's showers, faucets, or valves, each item is made to last and transform your home with efficiency and environmental awareness.
